Maya (CS Lead): Heads up — HealthCorps (regulated customer) asked for a monthly operational digest that includes uptime %, P50/P95 latency per route, incident rollups (incidents > P1), root-cause notes, and an explicit credit calculation breakdown per their contract. They also want a short SOC-friendly runbook we can hand to their security team. Can we get a draft by Tue EOD?

Ethan (SRE): I can pull the metrics and export a CSV. Quick query I plan to run in observability to get p50/p95 by route:

```
SELECT route,
       quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50_ms,
       quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms,
       avg(case when success=1 then 1 else 0 end)*100 AS uptime_pct,
       countIf(severity>1) AS incidents_count
FROM requests
WHERE customer = 'healthcorps' AND ts >= now() - 30d
GROUP BY route
```

I'll attach a sample CSV to the internal drive once export finishes. tagging @ops-bot to kick the export.

Priya (AE): We need Legal to confirm the credit calculation exactly matches the contract language before we show the customer. The formula we've been using in CS is: `credit = max(0, (SLA_target - observed_uptime)/SLA_target * monthly_fee * proration_factor)`. @Sam can you confirm?

Sam (Legal): That formula matches the high-level math, yes. Two caveats: 1) clause 4.2 caps credits at 25% of the monthly fee, and 2) the customer must provide an evidence package (metric export + request IDs + timeline) before credit is issued. I'll DM the exact phrasing and confirm whether we should include the cap explicitly in the digest.

ops-bot: export task created: export_id=exp-2026-04-12-001 status: queued

Ethan (SRE): Export finished, uploaded sample CSV: https://redwood.internal/drive/healthcorps/digest-sample.csv. Columns: `date,route,uptime_pct,p50_ms,p95_ms,incidents_count,credit_amount_usd`.

Ethan (SRE): Example credit calc (python) I plan to include as a column in the CSV for transparency:

```
# simple per-route credit calc
def compute_credit(sla_target, observed_uptime, monthly_fee, proration_factor, cap=0.25):
    raw = max(0.0, (sla_target - observed_uptime) / sla_target) * monthly_fee * proration_factor
    return min(raw, monthly_fee * cap)
```

Priya (AE): I'll coordinate a 30-min review with HealthCorps and their SOC to walk the runbook and digest. Proposed: Wed 11:00am PT. I'll send calendar invite to healthcorps-tech@healthcorps.com and attach the sample CSV as a pre-read.

Ethan (SRE): One more ask — we should include a mapping of customer-visible routes to underlying model endpoints and regions so they can correlate latency spikes to deployments. I'll add `route -> model_endpoint` mapping doc to the drive.

Maya (CS Lead): Great. Action items and owners:
- Ethan: full CSV export + runbook draft + route->endpoint mapping by Tue 12:00pm PT.
- Sam: confirm clause wording and cap + note on required evidence by Tue EOD.
- Priya: customer invite + pre-read distribution by Tue EOD.
- Maya: compile final digest and send to customer Wed morning.

Please react with :thumbsup: if you can commit to these timelines.

Priya (AE): :thumbsup: booked Wed 11am PT and sent invite.

Sam (Legal): I'll send the clause text to this thread and DM the contract excerpt.

Ethan (SRE): :thumbsup: CSV + runbook draft done, uploaded to the drive (same link). I'll post a short README with extraction steps for HealthCorps SOC.

Maya (CS Lead): Thanks team — will pull the compiled digest Wed 8:30am and do a quick QA before sending. If anything changes ping here.
